prompt: Day-by-day weather tiles for a place.
shortDesc: Row of daily weather tiles for a place (icon, high/low in °C, chance of rain; today highlighted). Give it the place, plus start-date and end-date for specific dates (defaults to the next 7 days); it fetches the weather itself and notes when it shows last year's weather instead of a forecast.

props.name: place
props.description: City or place, e.g. "Porto" or "Porto, Portugal".

styling.tailwindClasses: grid grid-flow-col auto-cols-[minmax(76px,1fr)] gap-2 p-4 overflow-x-auto
styling.notes: Sky tiles, today in harbour navy with white text; DM Mono temperatures.

interactions.bodyShape: { intent: 'get the daily weather', place, startDate?, endDate?, outputFormat: { note, days: [{ date, summary, weatherCode, tempMaxC, tempMinC, precipitationChance }] } }
